description: Source code implementing DNS utility functions related to mDNS endpoints and HTTPS query name generation within the Chromium project.

classes.name: IPEndPoint
classes.description: Represents an IP address and port combination used in network endpoints.

methods.name: GetMdnsIPEndPoint
methods.description: Constructs an IPEndPoint for a given IPv4 or IPv6 multicast address.

methods.name: GetMdnsGroupEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the multicast group endpoint for mDNS based on address family.

methods.name: GetMdnsReceiveEndPoint
methods.description: Returns the endpoint to receive mDNS messages, platform-dependent.

methods.name: GetNameForHttpsQuery
methods.description: Generates a DNS query name for HTTPS based on URL scheme, host, and port.
